subject: DPA negotiation — audit scope, subprocessors, and e-signature
messages:
From: Elena Rios <elena.rios@cloudbridge.io>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@cloudbridge.io, security.ops@cloudbridge.io
Date: 2026-09-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Initial DPA request + audit & evidence

Sergio —

Thanks for the intro. CloudBridge is moving to finalize our contract with Redwood and we need to close privacy terms before procurement will issue PO. A few items we need clarified before legal can sign:

- Explicit audit rights: CloudBridge needs the ability to conduct or appoint an independent auditor to validate Redwood's controls relevant to the DPA once per 12 months. Please confirm scope and notice requirements.
- Evidence: We need SOC 2 Type II report (redacted OK), and a high-level pen test summary. If you cannot share artifacts, please provide an alternate evidence workflow.
- Subprocessors: please confirm the current subprocessors list and your process for notification/approval for critical subprocessors.
- Data transfers: we require approach for cross-border transfers (SCCs / appropriate safeguards).

If you can send an editable DPA with redlines or your standard response text, procurement will try to get us to e-sign the final once legal confirms.

Thanks — happy to hop on 30-min call if that helps.

Elena Rios
Senior Counsel, CloudBridge
elena.rios@cloudbridge.io

Attachments: none (requesting artifacts)

From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
To: Elena Rios <elena.rios@cloudbridge.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-29T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial DPA request + audit & evidence

Elena —

Appreciate the clear list. I've attached a redline of our standard DPA with notes on the audit clause and subprocessors. Quick summary up-front:

- Audit rights: we are generally open to third-party audits under a scoped process (mutual NDA, limited scope to Redwood controls relevant to the services, and 30 days' advance notice). We typically require that an auditor be agreed in writing and that the audit avoid operational disruption.
- Evidence: attaching our SOC 2 Type II redacted summary and a one-page pen test digest. For deep artifacts (full reports), we can provide a read-only shared folder to an agreed auditor under NDA.
- Subprocessors: current list included in the DPA redline appendix; critical subprocessors flagged. We do not require affirmative pre-approval for every subprocessor but will notify 30 days ahead of any new critical subprocessor and offer an alternative where feasible.
- Data transfers: we rely on SCCs for EU transfers and offer contractual safeguards for other regions; we do not currently maintain BCRs.

If the above is acceptable in principle, I can send the redlined DPA via DocuSign for execution (Redwood signs first, CloudBridge countersigns) — our sales ops prefers that flow to keep a single envelope.

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_redlines_20260929.pdf; SOC2-TypeII-summary-2026-08-redacted.pdf; pen_test_digest_2026-07.txt

—
Sergio Alvarez
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Elena Rios <elena.rios@cloudbridge.io>, sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, procurement@cloudbridge.io
Date: 2026-09-30T10:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial DPA request + audit & evidence

Elena / team —

Quick clarifications from legal:

- Audit language: Redwood proposes a limited audit right that allows CloudBridge to either (1) review Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report and supporting attestations, or (2) appoint an independent auditor to perform a scoped assessment of controls pertinent to CloudBridge's use of the service. In the latter case, audits require:
  • a mutual NDA executed between CloudBridge, Redwood and the auditor;
  • a defined scope and duration mutually agreed;
  • no more than one on-site assessment per 12 months unless critical incident occurs;
  • remediation timeline for findings tied to severity.

- Subprocessors: instead of a blanket approval process, we can add a short notice-and-objection window for "critical subprocessors" (defined in the appendix). If CloudBridge reasonably objects, we'll use commercially reasonable efforts to propose an alternative.

- Evidence delivery: for procurement, we'll send the SOC2 redaction and a pen test executive summary. We cannot share raw pen test PII or exploit code; for deeper technical review we require an auditor engagement.

If CloudBridge accepts the high-level approach, we will prepare the final redline and a DocuSign envelope. Happy to adjust the exact notice windows — propose we continue with 30 days for both audits and subprocessor notifications.

Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Commercial Contracts — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: OCR guidance for SOC2 redaction (internal note) — not attached to external email

From: Elena Rios <elena.rios@cloudbridge.io>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@cloudbridge.io, security.ops@cloudbridge.io
Date: 2026-09-30T14:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial DPA request + audit & evidence

Marissa / Sergio —

Thanks for the detail — that layout is much closer to what legal wants. A couple of requests before we proceed to e-signature:

1) CloudBridge needs explicit written right to appoint an independent auditor (we can accept your mutual NDA + scoping requirements but we need the appointment right in the DPA).
2) Procurement asks for a 30-calendar-day notice window for scheduled audits and for subprocessor additions, and an exception if a high-severity incident occurs.
3) For pen test artifacts, we need at minimum: executive summary, high-level vulnerability categories, and confirmation that critical/CVSS>9 findings (if any) were remediated or mitigated. Redacted detailed findings are acceptable.

If you can incorporate (1)-(3) into the final redline, procurement will be willing to sign via DocuSign the same day once we receive the envelope. Can you send the envelope to procurement@cloudbridge.io?

Also — small ask: CloudBridge procurement prefers that the vendor signs first when the vendor is providing a standard agreement. If Redwood can sign and then route to procurement, that will help speed internal approval.

Elena

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: Elena Rios <elena.rios@cloudbridge.io>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-01T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial DPA request + audit & evidence — security artifacts

Elena —

Copying a short security note and artifacts we can provide:

- SOC2: link to redacted Type II report is in the shared drive (redacted for customer PII). We will also provide the SOC2 bridge letter for customers under NDA.
- Pen test: attached is the pen_test_digest_2026-07.txt which summarizes scope, methodology, and remediation status for high/critical issues. We cannot share exploit PoCs or raw logs.
- Auditor access: we are amenable to an auditor assessment under NDA. Our standard playbook: scope definition, mutual NDA, evidence exchange via secure read-only folder, and a 1-2 day remote interview with our security leads. On-site audits will be considered but require 60 days' advance scheduling and a separate SOW to cover costs.
- Data transfers: for EU/EEA transfers we apply SCCs and will sign the controller-to-processor addendum where applicable. For US <-> non-EU transfers, we use contractual safeguards. No BCRs currently.

Attachments: pen_test_digest_2026-07.txt; link: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/CB/SOC2-TypeII-Redacted

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Security — Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
To: Elena Rios <elena.rios@cloudbridge.io>, procurement@cloudbridge.io
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-02T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Finalizing DPA redline & DocuSign envelope (next steps)

Elena / procurement —

Thanks — we've incorporated your requested edits into the attached redline:

- Added explicit auditor appointment language with mutual NDA and defined scope; retained a 30-calendar-day notice for scheduled audits and subprocessor additions.
- Included language on evidence delivery: SOC2 Type II redacted report and pen test executive summary. For deeper artifacts we will require auditor NDA and scoped access.
- Removed the overly restrictive subprocessor pre-approval clause and replaced it with the notice-and-objection process for critical subprocessors.
- Confirmed SCCs will be applied for EU transfers; included a transfer annex.

I've created a DocuSign envelope for the redlined DPA where Redwood will sign first and then route to procurement@cloudbridge.io and Elena. Envelope link: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC123-Redwood-CB (DocuSign will send notifications). Please confirm receipt and let me know if procurement requires the envelope to include any PO reference in the metadata.

If we get countersignatures this week we can start provisioning dedicated capacity on our pilot cluster the week of Oct 12.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 15-20 min sync if there are any last open items.

—
Sergio Alvarez
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Attachments: Redwood_DPA_redlines_20261002.pdf; SOC2-TypeII-summary-2026-08-redacted.pdf; pen_test_digest_2026-07.txt
